agent_priors_used: General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): autonomous research programmes drift toward local continuations of recently active threads, so a periodic whole-program re-evaluation is needed to escape local optima; used only to justify the cognitive reset, not any claim.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a benchmark cannot demonstrate treatment value against a comparator already at ceiling, so dynamic range must be certified before an expensive run; note SPIDER also has bounded evidence for this in EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440, so the prior and the evidence agree without the prior being treated as evidence.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): capability-limited small/local models frequently fail multi-step tool-use because of prompt/format underspecification rather than an intrinsic ceiling, so a prompt-specification manipulation is a cheap, discriminating test before closing a provisioning route; used for Intel's terminal close-or-re-scope decision.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a degenerate measurement route is better terminated by a pre-registered fail-loudly gate than re-run indefinitely; used to endorse Graph's constructibility certificate with a mandatory park branch.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): crawl depth/hop cost is often collapsed by site-native discovery surfaces (robots sitemap directives, sitemaps, feeds, on-site search, JSON-LD) rather than by link-following BFS; used to select Frontier's discovery-vs-depth question and to keep it cheap and credential-free.

General prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): server-side access barriers (403 challenge pages, 429 rate limits, transport failures) exhibit session/rate/burst dependence that an adaptive scheduler can exploit; used to endorse Physics' barrier onset/recovery observable as a genuinely new level of description.

Landing the carrier therefore strictly dominates.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: Program map: 434 canonical experiments across six lanes, 2 quarantined. The decisive causal chain (observe -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the SHIPPED treatment -> applicability/freshness decision -> real external-agent action -> lower end-to-end cost per successful partially novel task after retrieval/verification/repair/maintenance) is still NOT validated end to end, and the program has converged on three binding readiness prerequisites, none of which currently holds. (B1) The shipped src/spider/kernel.py still exposes only literal distill() (confidence 0.5) and no audited distill_parameterized carrier, so there is no promoted treatment to run (program audit B1; EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 shows the parameterized round trip is live and causally attributable only outside the shipped path). (B2) Every credential-free deterministic REST task bank tested keeps cold re-derivation and retrieval-shaped comparators at the success=1.0 ceiling, so the cost/novelty test has no dynamic range (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440, frozen overall FALSIFIES of row C1; EXP-PRODUCT-37982016598 C1 gate FAILED). (B3) The credential-free CPU-quantized endpoints and local models tested cannot drive even a minimal multi-step Web-agent task (EXP-INTEL-37973264582; EXP-INTEL-37982024058 0/5 and 0/5 under the frozen underspecified prompt). Because all three are open I do NOT authorize the expensive four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / flagship C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark for any lane this cycle; the correct allocation is to keep removing these blockers plus the two science tracks that already have mid-flight transactions. Every lane currently holds an in-flight transaction that is a direct blocker-removal or decision-changing step: Product (B1 shipped-carrier landing, PREFREEZE), Runtime (B2 non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery task-bank certificate, PREFREEZE), Intel (B3 credential-free endpoint close-or-re-scope, PREFREEZE), Graph (C-FRESHNESS >=2-anchor D1V constructibility stop/go with an explicit fail-loudly park branch, PREFREEZE), Frontier (site-native discovery v2 over a pre-freeze-certified DEEP sampling frame, PREFREEZE), Physics (access-barrier onset/recovery, FROZEN and therefore to be completed under its frozen design). I confirm all six with CONTINUE; parent dispositions are USE for graph/physics/intel/frontier and SUPERSEDE for product/runtime, where the prior cycle correctly superseded the now-blocked flagship parents (the four-arm real-LLM benchmark and the out-of-surface oracle scope-expansion) with their respective prerequisite work. No idle/stalled lane is left accidental, and no new expensive benchmark execution is funded while (B1)-(B3) are open.
